question: Having or showing a strong desire for revenge
solution: He is a very vindictive man who never forgets a slight. वह जो हमेशा बदला लेने की फिराक में रहे (प्रतिशोधी)।

question: A new project or business activity involving some risk
solution: Starting a startup is a bold venture for any young entrepreneur. कोई नया प्रोजेक्ट या व्यापारिक कार्य जिसमें थोड़ा जोखिम (risk) शामिल हो।

question: Having or showing an excessively high opinion of one's appearance
solution: She is very vain about her looks. वह व्यक्ति जिसे अपनी सुंदरता या अपनी क्षमताओं पर बहुत ज़्यादा घमंड (अहंकार) हो।

question: The evening prayer service in a church
solution: The choir sang during the vespers. गिरजाघर में शाम के समय की जाने वाली प्रार्थना।

question: Something of high quality belonging to a past era
solution: He has a collection of vintage cars. कोई पुरानी और उत्कृष्ट वस्तु।

question: The area near or surrounding a particular place
solution: There are several shops in the vicinity of the park. किसी स्थान का आस-पास का क्षेत्र।

question: One who wanders from place to place without a settled home
solution: A vagabond travels around having no permanent address. वह व्यक्ति जिसका कोई स्थायी घर नहीं होता और वह इधर-उधर घूमता रहता है (खानाबदोश)।

question: A person who wanders from place to place without a home or job
solution: The city had many vagrants living on the streets. वह बेघर व्यक्ति जो इधर-उधर आवारा घूमता है।

question: A trace of something that no longer exists
solution: These ruins are the last vestige of an ancient city. किसी चीज़ का बचा-खुचा निशान या अवशेष।

question: The speed of something in a particular direction
solution: The velocity of the wind was recorded by the radar. किसी निश्चित दिशा में चलने वाली गति (वेग)।

question: One who speaks without moving the lips, creating an illusion
solution: The ventriloquist entertained the crowd with his dummy. वह कलाकार जो बिना होंठ हिलाए इस तरह बोलता है कि आवाज़ कहीं और से आती लगे।

question: The quality of using more words than are needed
solution: The speaker was criticized for his verbosity. ज़रूरत से ज़्यादा शब्दों का उपयोग करने का गुण।

question: To waver between different opinions or actions
solution: If you vacillate, you keep changing your mind. जब कोई व्यक्ति किसी निर्णय पर पहुँचने के लिए हिचकिचाता है या निश्चय नहीं कर पाता।

question: A simultaneous discharge of shots or missiles
solution: The soldiers fired a volley of bullets. बंदूकों या तीरों की एक साथ होने वाली बौछार।

question: A person who is unduly anxious about their health
solution: A valetudinarian spends too much time worrying about being ill. वह व्यक्ति जिसे अपनी सेहत को लेकर हमेशा बहुत ज़्यादा चिंता रहती है।

question: The cultivation of grapevines
solution: The region is famous for its viticulture and wine production. अंगूर की खेती।

question: Having a lively, attractive personality
solution: She is a vivacious person who is always the life of the party. जो बहुत फुर्तीला और जोश से भरा हुआ हो।

question: To clear someone of blame or suspicion
solution: New evidence will vindicate the innocent man. किसी पर लगे आरोपों को गलत साबित कर उसे निर्दोष ठहराना।

question: Containing more words than necessary
solution: He has a verbose writing style. वह लेख या भाषण जिसमें ज़रूरत से ज़्यादा शब्दों का प्रयोग किया गया हो।

question: The killing of a prophet
solution: Vaticide is the term used for the murder of a prophet. किसी पैगंबर या भविष्यवक्ता की हत्या।

question: In relation to or in comparison with
solution: They discussed the advantages of oil vis-à-vis coal. किसी के संबंध में या उसकी तुलना में।

question: Seeking to harm someone in return for a perceived injury
solution: He gave her a vengeful look. बदला लेने की भावना से भरा हुआ।

question: Having a very eager appetite, especially for food or reading
solution: He is a voracious reader and finishes three books a week. जिसकी भूख या लालसा बहुत अधिक हो।

question: A decision made by a jury in a court
solution: The jury reached a verdict of 'not guilty'. अदालत में जज या जूरी द्वारा दिया गया फ़ैसला।

question: Of one's own free will
solution: Participation in the survey is completely voluntary. जो काम अपनी इच्छा से किया जाए (स्वैच्छिक)।

question: One who makes long journeys, especially by sea
solution: The early voyagers discovered new continents while sailing across the oceans. वह यात्री जो लंबी, विशेषकर समुद्री यात्राएं (sea journeys) करता है।

question: One who does not eat meat
solution: He became a vegetarian for health reasons. वह व्यक्ति जो मांस नहीं खाता (शाकाहारी)।

question: A person who does not eat or use any animal products
solution: A vegan avoids milk and honey as well. वह व्यक्ति जो मांस के साथ-साथ किसी भी जानवर से बनी चीज़ (जैसे दूध) का इस्तेमाल नहीं करता।

question: A long sea journey
solution: The ship set off on a long voyage across the Pacific. जहाज़ से की जाने वाली लंबी समुद्री यात्रा।

question: In exactly the same words as were used originally
solution: She repeated the conversation verbatim. किसी बात को बिल्कुल शब्द-प्रतिशब्द हूबहू दोहराना।

question: Extremely severe or harmful in its effects
solution: The patients were suffering from a virulent form of the flu. बहुत ही विषैला या घातक।

question: A sin or fault that is not serious and can be forgiven
solution: Telling a small white lie is considered a venial sin. वह छोटी गलती या पाप जिसे माफ किया जा सके (क्षमा योग्य)।

question: Accorded great respect, especially because of age or wisdom
solution: The venerable old professor was loved by all students. उम्र या ज्ञान के कारण अत्यंत सम्मानित व्यक्ति।

question: An evil or wicked character, especially in a story
solution: In the movie, the villain is eventually caught. कहानी या नाटक का दुष्ट पात्र (खलनायक)।

question: One who deliberately damages public property
solution: The vandals broke the windows of the public library. वह व्यक्ति जो जानबूझकर सार्वजनिक संपत्ति को नुकसान पहुँचाता है।

question: Easily evaporated at normal temperatures
solution: Petrol is a highly volatile liquid. वह पदार्थ जो सामान्य तापमान पर भाप बनकर उड़ जाए (वाष्पशील)।

question: An animal with a spinal cord
solution: Humans and birds are examples of vertebrates. वे जीव जिनमें रीढ़ की हड्डी पाई जाती है।

question: A person qualified to treat diseases and injuries in animals
solution: We took our cat to the veterinarian for a checkup. पशुओं का डॉक्टर (पशु चिकित्सक)।

question: Having many different skills
solution: He is a versatile actor who can play any role. वह व्यक्ति जो अनेक कार्यों या कलाओं में निपुण हो (बहुमुखी)।

question: A person possessing outstanding technical ability in an art
solution: She is a piano virtuoso. वह व्यक्ति जो किसी कला (जैसे संगीत) में अत्यंत कुशल हो।

question: A person who is long experienced in an activity
solution: He is a veteran of the Second World War. वह व्यक्ति जिसे किसी विशेष कार्य या क्षेत्र का लंबा अनुभव हो।

question: One who freely offers to do something
solution: The charity relies on help from volunteers. वह व्यक्ति जो अपनी मर्ज़ी से सेवा प्रदान करे।

question: Showing strong feeling
solution: He made a vehement denial of the accusations. अपनी बात को बहुत उग्रता या जोश के साथ कहना।

question: Use of too many words or difficult words to express an idea
solution: His report was full of unnecessary verbiage. शब्दों का बहुत ज़्यादा आडंबर (शब्दाडंबर)।

question: A prolonged bitter quarrel, especially involving murder in revenge
solution: The two families have been involved in a long vendetta. बदला लेने के लिए वर्षों तक चलने वाली खानदानी दुश्मनी (प्रतिशोध)।

question: Having clear ideas about what should happen in the future
solution: Steve Jobs was a true visionary in the tech world. वह व्यक्ति जिसकी भविष्य को लेकर सोच बहुत स्पष्ट और महान हो।

question: A low area of land between hills
solution: The village is situated in a beautiful green valley. पहाड़ों या पहाड़ियों के बीच का निचला इलाका (घाटी)।

question: The faculty or power of using one's will
solution: He left the job of his own volition. अपनी खुद की इच्छा शक्ति का प्रयोग करना।

question: A morally good quality or behaviour
solution: Patience is a virtue. व्यक्ति का अच्छा गुण या सदाचार (सद्गुण)।

question: Exposed to the possibility of being attacked or harmed
solution: Children are the most vulnerable members of society. वह जो असुरक्षित हो और जिसे आसानी से नुकसान पहुँचाया जा सके।

question: To regard with great respect
solution: Many people venerate the memory of national heroes. किसी के प्रति बहुत गहरा सम्मान प्रकट करना।

question: Conformity to facts
solution: We need to check the veracity of his statement. किसी बात की सच्चाई या तथ्यों के साथ उसकी सटीकता।

question: The opinions or beliefs of the majority; public opinion
solution: The referendum is a way to hear the vox populi. लैटिन शब्द जिसका अर्थ है 'जनता की आवाज़' या जनमत।

question: Physical strength and energy
solution: He started the new project with great vigour and enthusiasm. शरीर की शक्ति, जोश और ऊर्जा।

question: A short descriptive piece of writing about a person, place, or event
solution: The book is a collection of vignettes about life in rural India. किसी व्यक्ति या स्थान का संक्षिप्त और प्रभावशाली चित्रण या लघु वर्णन।

question: In a manner experienced through another person
solution: Parents often live vicariously through the success of their children. दूसरे के अनुभवों के माध्यम से किसी चीज़ को महसूस करने का तरीका।

question: Experienced through another person
solution: She got a vicarious thrill from reading about her friend's travels. वह अनुभव जो स्वयं न करके दूसरे के माध्यम से प्राप्त हो।

question: Doing something out of free will
solution: He voluntarily offered to help with the relief work. बिना किसी दबाव के अपनी मर्ज़ी से कोई काम करना।

question: Not exact or clear
solution: His explanation was very vague, so I didn't understand the plan. वह बात या स्थिति जो बिल्कुल स्पष्ट या निश्चित न हो (अस्पष्ट)।

question: Great courage in battle
solution: The soldiers were honored for their valour during the war. युद्ध के मैदान में दिखाई गई असाधारण वीरता या साहस।

question: The native language or dialect of a region
solution: He wrote several poems in the local vernacular. किसी क्षेत्र विशेष की अपनी स्थानीय भाषा या बोली।
